milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining the crafting table block drops it as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no crafting_table in inventory, so having one confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a ladder (7 sticks in H-pattern on 3x3 grid) places the resulting ladders directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no ladders, so having one confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a jungle door (6 jungle planks in 2x3 pattern on 3x3 grid) places the resulting doors directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no jungle doors, so having one confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafting yellow stained glass (8 glass surrounding 1 yellow dye on 3x3 grid) places the resulting blocks directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no yellow stained glass, so having one confirms successful crafting.
